skills.skillName: Async Python FastAPI & Pydantic V2 Services

skills.description: Normalized database design, indexed foreign keys, transactional integrity, and idempotency.
bestPractices: Always index lookup columns and foreign key references
Wrap multi-row mutations in ACID transactions
Use timestamp with time zone (TIMESTAMPTZ) for all audit fields
Implement soft-deletes with active boolean flags where applicable

skills.description: Cryptographic JWT tokens, refresh token rotation, CORS headers, and rate limiting.
bestPractices: Hash passwords with minimum 12 bcrypt salt rounds
Store sensitive tokens in httpOnly secure cookies or bearer auth headers
Validate input payloads against strict regex and schema checkers
Sanitize all user-provided strings against XSS injection

Provide automated health checks and schema verification

archetypes.whyPickJustification: Picked Node.js/Express with TypeScript because of its lightweight memory footprint, instantaneous cold-start, non-blocking I/O event loop, and vast ecosystem compatibility.

archetypes.architectureSummary: Producer-Consumer pipeline with bounded concurrency, retry queues, and idempotent storage.

archetypes.whyPickJustification: Picked Python with asyncio and Pydantic because Python excels in robust HTML parsing, structured data manipulation, and rapid prototyping while retaining bulletproof type assertions.
